title: Complete v1alpha1 reconciliation and safety contracts
description: Implement all advertised Forgejo resources, adoption, finalizers, Orphan/Delete behavior, immutable remote identities, same-namespace Secret references, generated credential lifecycle, authoritative declared-field drift, and explicit collection pruning.
acceptance_criteria: All 14 resources reconcile as documented; credentials never leak; unit and envtest coverage verifies adoption, immutability, duplicate ownership, missing references, deletion policies and Secret stability/rotation.
notes: All 14 kinds reconcile; production adoption and Argo robot rollout validated. Forgejo 15 fixes now covered by unit tests: organization membership is established through teams because direct member PUT is unsupported; access-token creation locates the same-namespace managed robot and uses its generated password with Basic Auth, since admin-token sudo is rejected. Image d91948802e2b passed Go/vet/Nix checks and production E2E private-flake resolution. Remaining before closing: explicit collection-pruning tests and envtest/integration matrix.
